name: drupal-breakpoints

label.title: A human readable label for the breakpoint

schema.title: JSON schema for Drupal breakpoints file

description:
Below is the breakpoint configuration we will be using for the upcoming responsive redesign. The “small” breakpoint – labelled **Small (mobile)** – applies to any viewport up to 599 px wide (`all and (max-width: 599px)`). It carries the lowest positional weight of 0, supports pixel‑ratio multipliers of **1x** and **2x**, and belongs to the default group.

The next tier, **Medium (tablet)**, targets screens from 600 px through 899 px (`all and (min-width: 600px) and (max-width: 899px)`). Assigned a weight of 1, it also sits in the default group and accommodates three resolution multipliers: **1x**, **1.5x**, and **2x**.

Finally, the **Large (desktop)** breakpoint covers viewports of 900 px and wider (`all and (min-width: 900px)`), with a weight of 2. It remains in the default group and is compatible with **1x**, **2x**, and **3x** multipliers.
